name: Volkan Cevher
lab: Laboratory for Information and Inference Systems (LIONS)
one_sentence_summary: Volkan Cevher leads EPFL's LIONS lab, advancing machine learning through optimization theory, LLM training, sequence modeling, adversarial robustness, and multi-agent imitation learning.
matrix_summary: LIONS lab had a standout NeurIPS 2026 showing with 11 accepted papers (announced Oct 1), spanning optimization, sequence modeling (Raven), diffusion LMs, MoE theory, and multi-agent imitation learning. Several new preprints on reasoning models and attention mechanisms have also appeared since the last update.
